workload: two simultaneous greedy target-only requests, batch capacity 2, six generated tokens, selected positions 68 and 71
purpose: localize the early layer-1 MoE output change in a previously observed multirow numerical divergence
slot_mapping_method: all 36 committed GDN state layers compared at matching position/token to both fresh serial controls, mapping resolved independently per row
interpretation: At this selected boundary, shared-expert output and all captured upstream layer-1 fields match, while the combined MoE result differs. This narrows the discrepancy to routed expert output/combination or related per-row state, but does not identify an expert or establish causality. The short run does not reach the later token-60 output mismatch and is correctness instrumentation, not performance qualification.
